snippet.title: The Final Shift | Official Launch Trailer | Horror Game
snippet.description:
A quiet night. An empty building. A janitor with a simple task.

The Final Shift is a chilling psychological horror game where a monotonous night, cleaning identical floors as a janitor spirals into a mind-bending nightmare of warped realities, personal hauntings, and endless loops.

You are Dimitri Doru, a janitor on another late shift, begins his routine in a quiet paper company building. But each ride in the elevator distorts reality further, turning the ordinary into something deeply unsettling and pulling him into a nightmare he cannot escape.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4043920/The_Final_Shift/
